name: TutiPays — AI Dev Agent (approved request → draft PR)

nodes.name: Dev Desk Webhook
nodes.notes: Paste this node's Production URL into TutiPays -> Website settings -> Automation webhook. TutiPays posts { event, at, data } here; data has ticket_no, kind, title, description, plan, remark.

parameters.jsonBody:

nodes.name: Free AI: implementation notes
nodes.notes: Any free OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Add an httpHeaderAuth credential 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. Update the model string when your free model changes. continueOnError is on so a hiccup still opens the PR from the plan.

nodes.name: Assemble PR
nodes.notes: Edit owner / repo / base here for your repository.

nodes.name: GitHub: base ref
nodes.notes: Add an httpHeaderAuth credential 'Authorization: Bearer <GitHub PAT>' (repo scope). Reused by every GitHub node.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: 'chore: dev-agent spec for ' + $('Assemble PR').item.json.ticket, content: $('Assemble PR').item.json.specContentB64, branch: $('Assemble PR').item.json.branch }) }}

nodes.name: GitHub: commit spec
nodes.notes: Commits a task spec so the branch has a diff and the PR can open. Replace/extend this with real generated code changes when your coding agent produces them.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ title: $('Assemble PR').item.json.prTitle, head: $('Assemble PR').item.json.branch, base: $('Assemble PR').item.json.base, body: $('Assemble PR').item.json.prBody, draft: true }) }}

meta.description: Receives devdesk.approved from the TutiPays AI Dev Desk, asks a free AI for implementation notes, then creates a branch, commits a task spec, and opens a DRAFT PR built from the approved plan. Setup: (1) add an httpHeaderAuth credential 'Authorization: Bearer <GitHub PAT with repo scope>' and select it on every GitHub node; (2) set the AI URL/model + its Authorization credential; (3) edit owner/repo/base in the 'Assemble PR' node; (4) activate and paste this webhook's Production URL into TutiPays -> Website -> Automation webhook. The PR is a draft on purpose: a human reviews and completes the code before merge.
